title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Corridor 2 (Mangystau Oblast Sections) Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: The Project comprised civil works, and project management and institutional support. The civil works were on the reconstruction of the 200-km road sections at km 372.6-km 514.3 and km 574-km 632.3, including culverts and bridges, overpass, and road signs and signal posts along accident prone spots. The capacity development component supported program management and institutional strengthening. It included (i) construction supervision and project management; (ii) feasibility studies and detailed designs of subsequent tranche projects; and (iii) capacity development for road construction and maintenance, procurement design, management of contracts, enforcement of environmental and resettlement safeguards, and border crossing activities.

description.narrative: Increased transport connectivity and efficiency and improved institutional effectiveness

Reduced road user costs ($/vehicle-km) Progress/Status: The VOC savings per kilometer for different types of freight vehicles at completion are as follows: Articulated truck = $0.37/km 3 axle truck = $0.27/km 2 axle truck = $0.13/km Pick-up = $0.08/km Data Source: Manystau Statistics Office / MOTC traffic statistics Actual value:

Average processing time per truck at border crossing points reduced (minutes per truck) Progress/Status: Not applicable to Project 1. This was planned for Tranche 3 project, of which road section is near the Akzhigit-Uzbekistan border. Data Source: Customs Authority Actual value:

Increased traffic volume (vehicle per day) Progress/Status: Traffic volume along the 200-km Manasha-Shetpe road sections increased to 1,447 AADT in 2016 from 1,036 AADT in 2010.
Average daily vehicle-km (advk) along the 200-km road sections in Manasha-Shetpe registered at 290,067 advk in 2016 compared to 207,798 advk. Data Source: Mangystau Statistics Office / MOTC traffic statistics Actual value:

Reduced travel time between Aktau and Beineu (hours) Progress/Status: The travel time reduced by 2 hours and 45 minutes in 2016 from 4-5 hours in 2010c. Discounted travel time savings from along the 200-km project road registered at $45 million over the evaluation period of the project discounted at 12%. Data Source: Mangystau Statistics Office / MOTC traffic statistics Actual value:

Number of accidents per year on the corridor road reduced Progress/Status: Road crash savings along 200-km road is about 2 fatal and 3 injury casualties in 2016. Overall savings were found to total $8.85 million over the evaluation period of the project discounted at 12%. Data Source: Periodic classified traffic counts and accident data system Actual value:

National road safety improvement strategy with action plans prepared and implemented Progress/Status: Not applicable to Project 1. This is part of the government's initiatives. MID/CoR with ADB's assistance through the CAREC road safety strategy prepared a national road safety action plan for 2017-2020, which is currently being reviewed by concerned government agencies. Data Source: MOTC Annual Report Base year: 2009 Baseline value: N
